id: # Columns, the on grammar and driver keys: vault/architecture/guard-file-formats.md and
# vault/architecture/qg-dart-drivers.md in the vault-quality-gates repo. Empty cells are -.
# Push rows run on every pushed ref. The flutter-test and mutation-test rows run code the commit
# wrote, so they stay last: no row after them reads the tree or a shared report.

why: a push may not carry a changed Dart file that dart format would rewrite, so style changes never mix with logic changes in review
the flutter analyze issue count may not rise above its baseline, so new analyzer findings are fixed before release
functions with cyclomatic complexity over 20 may not grow in number, so every branchy function stays small enough to follow and test
import cycles between lib/ folders may not grow in number, so each folder can change without dragging its importers along

args: parser=jscpd artifact=quality-reports/jscpd/jscpd-report.json#percentage -- pnpm dlx jscpd@5.3.2 lib -c quality/jscpd.json --reporters json --no-colors
why: the share of duplicated lines in lib/ may not rise more than 0.1 points above its baseline, so shared logic is extracted instead of copied

args: parser=jscpd artifact=quality-reports/jscpd/jscpd-report.json#clones -- pnpm dlx jscpd@5.3.2 lib -c quality/jscpd.json --reporters json --no-colors
why: the number of duplicated blocks in lib/, read from the duplication report, may not rise above its baseline
comment lines per code line in lib/ may not rise more than 0.02 above the baseline, so code explains itself through names
domain code imports no Flutter material, cupertino or provider package, so the domain layer stays testable without widgets
domain code imports no API model, so a change to the server's JSON shape stays inside the data layer
colours come from AppColors or the colour scheme, never a raw Colors or Color(0x) literal, so a theme change reaches every screen
files in lib/ over 400 lines may not grow in number, so each file keeps one job a reader can hold in mind

args: -- grep -rlZ "Share\.\(share\|shareXFiles\|shareUri\)(" lib --include="*.dart" 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 -r -I{} awk 'function check_end(line){return (line ~ /\);/)} /Share\.(share|shareXFiles|shareUri)\(/{start=NR;buf=$0;found=($0~/sharePositionOrigin/);if(check_end($0)){if(!found)bad++;next}capturing=1;next}capturing{if($0~/sharePositionOrigin/)found=1;if(check_end($0)){capturing=0;if(!found)bad++}}END{print bad+0}' {} | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}'
why: every share_plus call passes a sharePositionOrigin, because iOS crashes when the share popover has no anchor
every future is awaited or wrapped in unawaited(), so an error thrown inside it is never silently lost
domain code imports nothing from lib/ui, so the domain layer never depends on screens
error classifiers for CDN assets match the URL path, never a givore.com host, so they keep working when assets move to another host

args: -- for p in lib; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { grep -rlE "extends ChangeNotifier( |\{|$)" lib --include="*.dart" | xargs -r grep -L "SafeNotifierMixin\|_isDisposed\|_disposed" | xargs -r grep -l "notifyListeners()" | xargs -r grep -l "await "; } | wc -l
why: a ChangeNotifier that notifies after an await guards against disposal, so a late notify never throws after the screen closes
an action IconButton never uses compact density, so its tap target stays at the 48 by 48 Material minimum

args: count=files paths=lib name=*.dart exclude=\.(g|freezed)\.dart$ -- static [A-Za-z<>?]+ get instance\b|static (final|const) *[A-Za-z<>?]* *_?instance *=
why: services are injected through constructors, never reached through a static instance, so each one can be replaced in a test
widget spacing uses Dimens and UiConstants tokens, never a raw number, so spacing stays consistent across screens
feed carousels never use ExpandablePageView, because its late resize makes the feed jump while the user scrolls
casts and JSON decodes are never guarded only by an on-Exception handler, because a TypeError escapes it and crashes the app
a primary ElevatedButton takes its look from the theme, never a style argument, so every primary action looks the same
icon SVGs declare fills inline, never in a style block, because flutter_svg ignores the block and tints the whole icon as a solid box
every copyWith merge in lib/data keeps the old value when the new one is null, so a partial update never erases a stored field

args: -- for p in lib/data/services/initialization/actions; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { { grep -L "isCritical" lib/data/services/initialization/actions/*.dart; grep -l "isCritical => true" lib/data/services/initialization/actions/*.dart; }; } | wc -l
why: every startup action declares isCritical and only the sanctioned one is critical, so startup order stays explicit and fast

args: -- for p in lib; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { { grep -rnE "ResolutionPreset\.(low|medium|high|ultraHigh|max)\b" lib --include="*.dart"; grep -rnE "\.(pickImage|pickMultiImage|pickMedia|pickMultipleMedia)\(" lib --include="*.dart" | grep -vE "^lib/data/services/(media/media_picker_service|avatar/avatar_service)\.dart:"; }; } | wc -l
why: camera presets stay at veryHigh and image pickers live in the two media services, so uploaded photos keep one resolution ceiling
an inline comment is at most two lines, so explanations that need more go into names or docs instead of the code

args: -- for p in lib/ui; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { grep -rnE "(Text\(|label: *|hintText: *|tooltip: *|message: *|title: *)'[A-Z][^'\$]*'|'[A-Z][a-z]+( [A-Za-z',]+)+[.!?]*'" lib/ui --include="*.dart" | grep -vE "\.(g|freezed|mocks)\.dart:" | grep -vE ":[0-9]+:\s*(//|\*)|_log\.|Log\.|log\(|print\(|Exception\(|Error\(|assert|Key\(|debug|ErrorReporter|reason:|[Ll]ogger|fontFamily|threw|'(Instagram|Facebook|TikTok|Google|Apple|Givore)'"; } | wc -l
why: text shown to users comes from the ARB files, never an English literal in lib/ui, so every screen is translated in every locale

args: -- for p in lib/l10n/app_en.arb lib/l10n/app_es.arb; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; jq empty lib/l10n/app_en.arb lib/l10n/app_es.arb || exit 2; { jq -r 'to_entries[]|select(.key|startswith("@")|not)|.value|tostring' lib/l10n/app_en.arb lib/l10n/app_es.arb | grep -iE "donat|recycl|sustainab|eco-friendly|carbon|platform|communit|donar|donaci|recicl|sostenib|ecol.gic|carbono|plataforma|comunidad"; } | wc -l
why: en and es copy never uses the banned brand words such as donate, recycle or community, so the app keeps its neighbourly voice

args: -- for p in lib/l10n/app_pt.arb; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; jq empty lib/l10n/app_pt.arb || exit 2; { jq -r 'to_entries[]|select(.key|startswith("@")|not)|.value|tostring' lib/l10n/app_pt.arb | grep -iwE "voc(ê|ês)|tela|celular|conosco"; } | wc -l
why: the pt copy uses European forms with informal tu, never Brazilian words such as você or celular, so Portuguese users read their own language
a screen saves only the user fields it owns, never the whole cached model, so it cannot overwrite a change made elsewhere

args: -- for p in lib pubspec.yaml; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { git grep -lE "^(<<<<<<<|>>>>>>>) "; } | wc -l
why: no file carries a committed merge conflict marker, so a broken merge never ships
tests dispose view-models through addTearDown, never as their last statement, so a failing test still cleans up

args: -- for p in lib/l10n/app_en.arb test; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; jq empty lib/l10n/app_en.arb || exit 2; { jq -r 'to_entries[]|select(.key|startswith("@")|not)|.value|tostring|select(test("[{}]")|not)|select(test(" "))' lib/l10n/app_en.arb | sed "s/.*/find.text('&')/" | grep -rnF -f - test --include="*.dart"; } | wc -l
why: tests find text through AppLocalizations, never an exact English string, so a copy change does not break unrelated tests

args: -- for p in test; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { for s in debugSetClockNow debugSetMessageClockNow debugMapTileProviderOverride; do grep -rlE "^[^/]*$s *(=|\() *[^n) ]" test --include="*.dart" | while read f; do grep -qE "^[^/]*$s *(=|\() *null" "$f" || echo "$f"; done; done; } | wc -l
why: tests that set a debug clock or map tile seam reset it to null, so a pinned global never leaks into the next test
analytics events never send an exception's text, only a closed category chosen from its type, so no raw error or personal data leaks

args: -- for p in lib/ui/premium lib/data/services/premium; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { grep -rnE "NumberFormat|€|£|toStringAsFixed|currencySymbol" lib/ui/premium lib/data/services/premium --include="*.dart" | grep -vE "^[^:]+:[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*//"; } | wc -l
why: premium code never formats money by hand, so a price or saving the app shows always comes from the store and never overstates

args: -- for p in lib/ui/settings/view_models/delete_account_viewmodel.dart; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { find lib/ui -name "delete_*.dart" -print0 | xargs -0 grep -nE "(^|[^A-Za-z_])await [^;]*(analytics|Analytics|track[A-Z]|flush\()"; } | wc -l
why: delete flows never await analytics, so a slow or failing tracker never blocks the user from finishing a deletion
the isLoading and error arguments of DetailBottomSheet stay literals, because the sheet hides its whole content while either is set

args: -- for p in lib/ui/posts/widgets/single_post_screen.dart lib/ui/user/views/single_user_screen.dart; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { grep -nE "^[^/]*\b(PostTile|IdeaTile|CommentsDetailBottomSheet|InlineCommentsSection)\(" lib/ui/*/widgets/single_*_screen.dart lib/ui/user/views/single_user_screen.dart; } | wc -l
why: detail screens never embed a feed tile or a comments sheet, so they keep the screen-owned sliver layout with inline comments
code never calls cancel on a PagingController, because dispose already stops its fetch and a manual cancel hides the real bug
the app never filters on a polymorphic _type column, because the server sanitizes the class name and the filter matches nothing
the nightly cron keeps waking and holding the device screen, because on-device tests receive no frames and time out on a dark screen

args: -- for p in integration_test/_support/e2e.dart; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { awk '/^Future<void> bootAndReachShell/{f=1} f&&/addTearDown\(\(\) => drainAndQuiesce\(tester\)\)/{print FNR} f&&/^}/{f=0}' integration_test/_support/e2e.dart; } | wc -l
why: bootAndReachShell keeps registering the drain through addTearDown, so live async stops even when an on-device test fails

args: -- for p in tool/quality.sh Makefile; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { grep -nE "flutter test[^\"]*integration_test/?( |\"|$)" tool/*.sh Makefile; } | wc -l
why: on-device tests run one file per flutter test call, never the whole integration_test folder, so one file's state cannot fail the next
on-device tests scroll to a hit-testable feed tile, never tap the first PostTile, which may be off screen right after boot

args: -- for p in integration_test; do [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "unmeasurable: $p missing or empty" >&2; exit 2; }; done; { grep -lE "^[^/]*(bootApp\(|app\.main\()" integration_test/*_test.dart | xargs -r grep -L "drainAndQuiesce\|bootAndReachShell"; } | wc -l
why: every on-device test file that boots the app also drains its live async, so the run does not hang at teardown
on-device tests wait for keyed loaded content, never find a screen by type, because the screen exists before its data arrives
lib/ files that are the same code under renamed names may not grow in number, so code calls the existing implementation instead of copying it
the file-dependency tangle score of lib/ may not rise more than 0.05 above its baseline, so a change keeps touching few files
imports that point up a layer may not grow in number, so domain, data and services never depend on the layers above them
functions nested deeper than 5 levels may not grow in number, so control flow stays readable
functions with more than 4 parameters may not grow in number, so call sites stay short and the inputs stay grouped in types
functions over 50 source lines may not grow in number, so each function stays short enough to read in one screen
classes with more than 10 methods may not grow in number, so each class keeps one responsibility
a commit may not add a refuse-tier lint hit or compile error on the lines it adds, so new code follows quality/RULES.md
warn-tier lint hits on the lines a commit adds are printed, so the author sees each quality/RULES.md breach before it piles up
a commit is warned when its added lines are part of a 10-line clone in lib/, so shared logic is extracted instead of pasted
a commit may not add an ignore or ignore_for_file comment to Dart code, so a lint finding is fixed instead of hidden
a commit may not change a protected gate file, so an agent cannot loosen the gate that judges it
a commit may not change the locked version of a measuring Dart tool or turn a package into a path or git one, so no one can swap the tool that scores them
a push may not carry a failing test, so a release branch always passes the whole suite
line coverage of lib/ may not drop more than half a point below its baseline, so new code ships with tests
the mutation score may not drop more than one point below its baseline, so the tests keep catching changed behaviour
replaced by format-files, which counts the changed Dart files dart format would rewrite instead of reading its exit code
replaced by comment-ratio, which runs cloc with no timeout so every file is counted
replaced by tests-failed, which counts the failing tests instead of reading the suite's exit code
replaced by coverage, which measures fresh coverage on every push
no Dart tool gives a composite code, complexity and architecture score, so the complexity and architecture rows measure those parts instead
no maintained Dart tool finds packages the code uses without declaring them in pubspec.yaml, so this check waits for its own research pass
replaced by protected-paths-touched, which reads the longer protected list in quality/config
